Monday, the 20th October, 2008/28 Asvina, 1930 (Saka)
The House met at eleven of the clock,
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair.
OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, I refer with profound sorrow to the passing
away of Shri Laxminarayan Sharma, a sitting Member of this House, on 17th October,
2008, at the age of 75 years.
Shri Sharma was born in September, 1933 at village Karondia, District Bhopal of
Madhya Pradesh, and had his education at Vikram University, Ujjain.
An agriculturist by vocation, Shri Sharma began his career as a teacher and was
associated with various social welfare organisations. Shri Sharma started his legislative
career with the Membership of the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly in 1967 and
was a Member of that Assembly continuously for 35 years. He also served as Minister
of Co-operatives, Revenue and Agriculture in the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
Shri Sharma represented the State of Madhya Pradesh in this House from June,
2004, till his sad demise.
In the passing away of Shri Laxminarayan Sharma, the country has lost a veteran
Parliamentarian, an administrator and a noted social worker. We deeply mourn the
passing away of Shri Laxminarayan Sharma.
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of respect
to the memory of the departed.
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute)
MR. CHAIRMAN : Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved
family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy.
As a mark of respect to Shri Laxminarayan Sharma, a sitting Member, the House
stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Tuesday, the 21st October, 2008.
The House then adjourned at three minutes past eleven of the clock
till eleven of the clock on Tuesday, the 21st October, 2008.
